frozen_at_rule: caller-supplied freeze date recorded by T13; nothing reads a wall clock
card_hash_rule: BROAD_TARGET_CARD_V1_SHA256 in brain/liquidity_lab/target_card.py: canonical SHA-256 of BROAD_TARGET_CARD_V1.to_dict() with sorted keys and separators (',', ':')

treatment.construction: causal expanding z of the weekly change in the weighted mean causal z of USD-converted log central-bank balance sheets: WALCL; ECBASSETSW converted with EURUSD=X; JPNASSETS converted with USDJPY=X (month_end)
treatment.timing: known_at under the T05 knowledge-time law (publication availability), never observed_at
treatment.constant_fx_variant: local-currency component from T04 decompose_fx_change; used only by the mechanical_target_overlap falsifier

outcome_family.return_basis: each entry's card basis (default total_return); no substitute basis
outcome_family.horizon_counting_rule: declared-calendar sessions from the card govern; an estimator horizon counted on supplied closes is admissible only when every declared session in the window is supplied, otherwise the outcome is immature and never shifted; implementation belongs to T15
outcome_family.basis_data_rights: UNRESOLVED: a licensed total-return or dividend-adjusted series per entry must be recorded before any outcome read (T14/T15 precondition)
outcome_family.funding_family_rule: a target is in the funding family when its return mechanically shares a component of the usd_funding composite (broad_dollar, real_yield_10y, high_yield_oas): rates and credit through yields and spreads; USD-quoted commodities and non-US equity funds through the dollar numeraire. Each such target is evaluated against a leave-target-family-out baseline (protocol section 6)

predictive.quantity: E[log(P_(anchor+h) / P_anchor) on the card basis | a measured monetary-impulse episode first known at known_at, information set I_known_at], h in the card planning horizons
conditioning_set: registered condition buckets us_liquidity_quality and usd_funding_impulse, measured at known_at
predictive.conditioning_note: usd_funding_impulse at known_at is partly a mediator; conditioning on it makes this a conditional predictive association and forbids any causal reading of the conditioned cells
predictive.interpretation: association only; never an effect of policy
predictive.novelty_requirement: must beat the direct-component and leave-target-family-out baselines of protocol section 6 on identical origins before any claim of incremental information
predictive.gate: T14 preregistration (one outcome, one horizon) and walk-forward validation before any read

causal.quantity: total response of the target log return at horizon h to an identified intervention in central-bank balance sheets, every mediator left free
causal.requires: identification_receipt: a named design with first-stage relevance, timing, exclusion argument, no-anticipation evidence and a threat analysis
causal.direct_effect_note: a direct effect holding a mediator fixed is a different estimand and is not declared

confounders.path: growth deterioration moves balance-sheet policy and asset returns together (reaction function)
stress episodes trigger emergency facilities that expand balance sheets while risk assets fall
inflation and the expected rate path drive purchase and runoff decisions and discount rates
TGA and ON RRP shifts change reserves relative to balance-sheet totals and move funding markets
policy reacts to market declines; trailing returns also carry momentum
a global risk factor moves policy, the dollar and every target
the dollar translates ECB and BoJ assets into the USD stance and prices USD-quoted targets

mediators.path: balance-sheet impulse to dollar to USD-quoted returns
balance-sheet impulse to term premium and real yields to duration assets
balance-sheet impulse to credit spreads to credit and equity
the macro usd_funding composite of the three channels above

colliders.path: realized post-treatment volatility or drawdown is caused by the impulse and by unobserved private shocks that also move returns
realized funding stress after the impulse is a common effect of policy and private funding shocks
keeping only episodes in which markets visibly reacted selects on a common effect of treatment and outcome noise

exclusion_assumptions.assumption: the treatment reaches returns only through policy channels, not through the accounting FX translation of ECB and BoJ assets
the balance-sheet change first known at known_at was not already priced
balance-sheet actions do not reveal central-bank information about growth or stress
emergency facility usage does not itself measure the stress that moves returns

falsifiers.threat: scheduled purchase and runoff paths are priced before publication, so the impulse at known_at is not news
falsifiers.test: split scheduled from unscheduled balance-sheet change; compare responses timed at announcement and at T05 known_at; the scheduled component must show no response at known_at
falsifiers.refutes: any claim that the published impulse moves returns

falsifiers.threat: balance sheets expand because markets and growth fell (facilities, QE restarts)
falsifiers.test: predict the impulse from lagged target returns, stress and growth news; report the response separately for reaction-driven and scheduled episodes
falsifiers.refutes: reading a negative association as policy harming returns or a positive one as policy helping

falsifiers.threat: a global risk shock moves the USD-converted stance and every target at once
falsifiers.test: response must survive the lagged common-risk-factor baseline and a cross-region comparison; the contemporaneous factor is never added as a control
falsifiers.refutes: attributing a common-factor move to liquidity transmission

falsifiers.threat: the dollar sits inside the USD-converted treatment and inside USD-quoted targets; the funding composite shares dollar, real yield and HY OAS with funding-family targets
falsifiers.test: leave-target-family-out baseline for every funding-family target, plus the constant-FX treatment variant from T04 decompose_fx_change
falsifiers.refutes: any response that vanishes under constant FX or leave-family-out

falsifiers.threat: pre-trends or spurious timing produce a response before the impulse is known
falsifiers.test: same estimator on lead windows ending before known_at and on pseudo-event dates drawn from non-event weeks under a fixed protocol
falsifiers.refutes: the timing of any measured response

falsifiers.threat: a candidate instrument with weak first stage or an indefensible exclusion yields a forced causal number
falsifiers.test: declare a relevance threshold before outcomes; below it, or with an undefended exclusion, the status is NOT_IDENTIFIED
falsifiers.refutes: every causal estimate built on that instrument

non_exogenous_constructions.where: any regression of the impulse on chosen regressors
non_exogenous_constructions.why_not_exogenous: orthogonal to the included regressors in sample only; still correlated with omitted drivers such as growth news, stress and the reaction function
a deterministic function of the same endogenous state; a threshold selects large endogenous moves and adds no outside variation; event_definition_id records the choice and identifies nothing
expanding-window OLS of the impulse on the stance; causal means no look-ahead, not identification; the residual remains a function of endogenous balance-sheet changes
an interval that excludes zero measures sampling uncertainty of an association; reverse reaction and common factors also produce significant cells; it is an output, not evidence about the input

abstention_reason: No external instrument or identified-intervention receipt exists. The measured impulse is the change in an endogenous state variable that responds to growth, inflation, financial stress and FX translation; eventization at a threshold does not make it an instrument; its exclusion assumptions are undefended or violated by construction. The causal estimand is not estimated. Only the predictive association may proceed, under T14 preregistration.
